resources.string: Needs internet. Connect the TV to watch or listen.
No special occasions this month. Fasting is recommended on Mondays, Thursdays and the 13th–15th.
A TV has no compass. Use a known direction: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

A short guide. For details and special cases, ask a trusted scholar.

string-array.name: wudu_steps
string-array.item: Make the intention in your heart and say “Bismillah”.
Wash both hands up to the wrists, three times.
Rinse the mouth, three times.
Breathe water gently into the nose and blow it out, three times.
Wash the whole face, three times.
Wash the right arm up to the elbow, then the left, three times each.
Wipe the head with wet hands, from front to back and back again, once.
Wipe the ears, inside and behind, once.
Wash the right foot up to the ankle, then the left, three times each.
Say the dua after wudu: “Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah…”.

string-array.name: prayer_steps
string-array.item: Make wudu, face the qibla and make the intention in your heart.
Raise your hands and say “Allahu Akbar”.
Recite Al-Fatiha, then a short surah.
Bow (ruku) and say “Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem” three times.
Stand up saying “Sami’allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal hamd”.
Prostrate (sujud) and say “Subhana Rabbiyal A’la” three times.
Sit up and say “Rabbighfir li”, then prostrate a second time.
Stand for the next rak’ah and repeat.
In the last sitting, recite the tashahhud and the salawat on the Prophet ﷺ.
Turn your head to the right, then to the left, saying “As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullah”.

string-array.name: umrah_steps
string-array.item: Ihram: at the miqat, wear the ihram clothes, make the intention for Umrah and start the talbiyah.
Tawaf: walk around the Kaaba seven times, starting and ending at the Black Stone, keeping the Kaaba on your left.
Pray two rak’ahs behind Maqam Ibrahim if possible, or anywhere in the mosque.
Drink Zamzam water.
Sa’i: walk seven times between Safa and Marwah, starting at Safa and ending at Marwah.
Shave the head or shorten the hair (women cut a fingertip’s length). Your Umrah is complete.

string-array.name: hajj_steps
string-array.item: 8 Dhul-Hijjah: enter ihram (for Hajj at-Tamattu’ from your place in Makkah) and go to Mina.
9 Dhul-Hijjah: stand at Arafah from after noon until sunset, in dhikr and dua.
Night of the 10th: go to Muzdalifah, pray Maghrib and Isha there, and spend the night.
10 Dhul-Hijjah: stone Jamrat al-Aqabah with seven pebbles, offer the sacrifice, and shave or shorten the hair.
Perform Tawaf al-Ifadah and the Sa’i of Hajj.
11–13 Dhul-Hijjah: stay in Mina and stone the three Jamarat each day after noon (you may leave after the 12th).
Before leaving Makkah, perform the farewell tawaf.
